creator_accounts_claim_code_pending.name: creator_accounts_claim_code_pending
creator_accounts_claim_code_pending.value: "creator_accounts"."claim_code" is null or ("creator_accounts"."claim_status" = 'pending' and "creator_accounts"."claim_code_at" is not null)

creator_requests_claim_contact.name: creator_requests_claim_contact
creator_requests_claim_contact.value: "creator_requests"."kind" <> 'claim' or ("creator_requests"."email" is not null and "creator_requests"."account_url" is not null)

creator_requests_email_len.name: creator_requests_email_len
creator_requests_email_len.value: "creator_requests"."email" is null or char_length("creator_requests"."email") between 3 and 320

creator_requests_message_len.name: creator_requests_message_len
creator_requests_message_len.value: "creator_requests"."message" is null or char_length("creator_requests"."message") between 1 and 1000

creator_users_email_format.name: creator_users_email_format
creator_users_email_format.value: "creator_users"."email" = lower("creator_users"."email") and char_length("creator_users"."email") between 3 and 320 and position('@' in "creator_users"."email") > 1

creators_bio_len.name: creators_bio_len
creators_bio_len.value: "creators"."bio" is null or char_length("creators"."bio") between 1 and 400

feedback_email_len.name: feedback_email_len
feedback_email_len.value: "feedback"."email" is null or char_length("feedback"."email") between 3 and 320

verification_checks_target.name: verification_checks_target
verification_checks_target.value: "verification_checks"."code_id" is not null or "verification_checks"."submission_id" is not null
